turns.patient_opening: Hi. I’ve been having a cough plus burning pain and pain in my forehead that also spreads to my right cheek, right temple, and even to my nose. I also lost my sense of smell, and I’ve had greenish/yellowish nasal discharge—this started after a cold about two weeks ago, and I’m worried it’s not getting better.

turns.doctor_question: Do you have polyps in your nose (nasal polyps)?
turns.patient_answer: Yes, I’ve been told I have polyps in my nose.

turns.doctor_question: Do you have asthma, or have you ever had to use a bronchodilator (like an inhaler for wheezing or shortness of breath) in the past?
turns.patient_answer: Yes, I have asthma, and I’ve used a bronchodilator/inhaler before.

turns.doctor_question: When you feel the pain, does it feel like a **tugging or pulling sensation**? (yes or no)
Do you think you’re more likely than most people to develop common allergies (like hay fever, dust allergies, or pet allergies)?
